texts.facts: This petition is filed by the minor petitioner through his guardian/natural father U/s.166 of Motor Vehicle Act, claiming compensation of .25,00,000/- for the injuries sustained by the petitioner in a road Traffic Accident. Prior to the accidental injuries, he was hale and healthy and was a student. Due to the accidental injuries he become permanent disabled. The accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of crane by its driver. The respondents being the owner and insurer of offending vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner. Further contended that due to own negligence of minor petitioner's father being the rider of motor cycle without taking proper precaution for safety of minor pillion rider with an intention to jump traffic signal unable to succeed his attempt came to sudden halt and SCCH 11 5 MVC.No.5774/2022 minor petitioner who was not intact on pillion seat, fell down due to negligence of rider of motor cycle. As per Master Mallikarjun case, the disability upto 10% to the whole body - .1 lakh. Accordingly the petitioner is entitled for .1,00,000/- under the head pain and suffering already undergone and to be suffered in future, mental and physical shock, hardship, inconvenience, and discomforts etc and loss of amenities in life on account of permanent disability. 17. Towards Medical Expenses: The petitioner has claimed compensation towards medical expenses. Hence the petitioner is entitled for .2,05,545/- under the head medical and incidental expenses during the period of hospitalization.
texts.arguments: 18. Towards loss of income during treatment: The petitioner has contended that his son was student and he has hospitalized due to injuries sustained by him in the Road Traffic Accident. So, when the father/mother of the petitioner was in the hospital along with petitioner, he has no income during that period. As such the petitioner is entitled for lump sum of .20,000/- under the head Discomfort, inconvenience and loss of earnings to the parents during the period of hospitalization.
